comment: Three minimal operations for the step-metadata tests: one that creates an atom, one that deletes one, one that only moves one. Together they cover the three ways an atom can relate to a layer — created by it, removed after it, merely nudged by it.

ops.name: grow
ops.comment: Adds a hydrogen onto a carbon. The only op here that creates an atom.

ops.name: strip
ops.comment: Abstracts a hydrogen. Used to delete an atom an earlier step created.

ops.name: nudge
ops.comment: Moves a carbon half an Angstrom along +x. Creates nothing, so a nudged atom must never join a layer set.
